name: Library (Ironforge)
summary: In Ironforge, the Explorers' League keeps its histories and recovered relics in the Library. The eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers holds books and artifacts gathered across Azeroth.

sections.title: Heart of the Explorers' League
sections.body: In the Hall of Explorers, dwarven scholars study relics and field reports in a great chamber. The Explorers' League keeps the Library, where shelves hold chronicles of the War of the Three Hammers, the ancient Troll Wars, and the origins of the dwarven race. Librarian Mae Paledust helps visitors find rare books and records.

sections.title: The Museum Displays
sections.body: Curator Thorius oversees displays of finds from deep excavations, abandoned ruins, and distant shorelines. League members study, preserve, and display these objects. The collection ranges from crude murloc idols and carved knives to relics recovered frozen in northern ice. Curators record each find as they piece together the history of the Titans and early Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Library in Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Library is the Explorers' League's main archive and museum. League members bring recovered artifacts, tomes, and field notes there to be cataloged, deciphered, and preserved for the dwarven people and the Alliance.
Librarian Mae Paledust helps visitors with written collections and archival searches. Curator Thorius oversees the museum wing and its physical historical artifacts.

faq.q: What kind of books can be read here?
faq.answer: The Library holds histories of ancient and modern events, including the Old Gods, the Dragonflights, the Troll Wars, the War of the Three Hammers, the Rise of the Horde, and the formation of the Alliance of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where in Ironforge is the Library located?
faq.answer: The Library occupies the eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers, in Ironforge's northeastern quadrant.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can find accounts here of the Awakening and the War of the Three Hammers. These records are kept in the hall King Magni Bronzebeard devoted to uncovering your Titan origins.
As an Alliance member, you can consult records from the Alliance of Lordaeron and eyewitness reports from the Second and Third Wars in the Library's strategic archive.
